app.notes: IGdm is an Electron desktop client for Instagram DMs. Setup (see install.sh): mise.toml pins node 16.20.2 and yarn 1.22.22. Dependencies are installed with `yarn install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` (Electron binary skipped), and `gulp html` (the repo's own build task) compiles browser/views/*.pug into browser/*.html. start.sh re-runs the seed so timestamps are relative to now, then starts .ui-capture/server.js. That server loads the real main/main.js with the stubs above and serves browser/ plus the bootstrap/nojs/moment files it references. The UI opens at /browser/index.html ('/' redirects to whatever page the main process loaded). Data: the account is @maya.okafor (Maya Okafor, a Portland ceramicist who runs Okafor Clay Studio). There are 30 conversations and about 340 messages spread over roughly 2.5 months. They include: best friend/studio-mate Jess (unread, active now); group chats 'Saturday Market Crew 🧺', 'Okafor Fam 🏡' and a muted 'Wheel Class — Tues 6pm'; customer threads (custom dinnerware order awaiting reply, mug repair, wedding registry, discount ask); a wholesale order of 64 mugs for Fern & Foundry Coffee; a clay supplier, market organizer, kiln repair tech, podcast invite, photographer, logo designer; and an unanswered spam 'ambassador' brand DM. Message types: text, likes, photos, shared posts and carousels, story replies (live and expired), links with previews, GIFs, voice notes, action logs, a removed-message placeholder, a view-once photo and heart reactions. Read/seen states and 'Active now / Last seen' presence vary. There are 357 users in total, with 203 following and 329 followers; about 26 accounts don't follow back. Main areas: chat list (left; the inbox shows the 20 most recent threads), conversation view with older-message loading on scroll-up, message composer with emoji picker and attachment menu, user search (top bar, type 4+ characters, e.g. 'jess', 'pottery', 'studio'), settings dropdown (hover the avatar top-left: seen receipts, notifications, 'Users not following back' viewer, log out), media viewer (click a photo/post), right-click context menus (quote message, delete conversation). Verification: headless Chrome can't start inside this sandbox, so there are no screenshots. Instead, every IPC round trip was exercised against the running server, and the unmodified renderer scripts (browser/js/*.js) were run in a Node vm against real responses for all 20 inbox threads with no errors.
